items.html: And indeed, all those gradations of the time of pregnancy are only the beginning of the repair, and after them come the gradations of nursing, and they are an additional repair upon the time of pregnancy. But the true final repair is in the Mochin of Gadlut, in the order of its gradations. And behold, in the Mochin of pregnancy it was explained there, that the purpose of their repair is that they contain the Aleph-Lamed-Mem of Elokim.
